## Core Renovation Services
- [HDB BTO & SBF Renovation](https://www.luxcraft.sg/services-pages/hdb-bto-sbf-renovation): Turnkey space planning, bespoke carpentry, wet masonry, and complete HDB permit filing for newly collected BTO/SBF flats. Standard 4-room budget ranges from $45,000 - $75,000 with a 6-8 week delivery timeline.
- [HDB Resale Renovation](https://www.luxcraft.sg/services-pages/hdb-resale-renovation): Comprehensive resale flat revitalization including structural wall hacking, complete re-plumbing and re-wiring, bathroom waterproofing, and customized storage solutions.
- [Condominium Renovation](https://www.luxcraft.sg/services-pages/condo-renovation): High-end residential remodeling with strict MCST by-law compliance, lift protection, space optimization, and luxury materials.
- [Landed Renovation](https://www.luxcraft.sg/services-pages/landed-renovation): Multi-storey spatial masterplanning for inter-terrace, semi-detached, and detached homes with indoor-outdoor architectural integration.
- [Commercial & Retail Fit-Out](https://www.luxcraft.sg/services-pages/commercial-renovation): SCDF fire code-compliant commercial transformations for boutique retail, historic shophouses, and modern corporate offices.
- [Partial Renovation](https://www.luxcraft.sg/services-pages/partial-renovation): Surgical kitchen, bathroom, and built-in wardrobe upgrades with dust containment and minimal disruption.

## Craftsmanship Standards & Technical USPs
- **100% Solid Plywood Construction**: LuxCraft exclusively crafts built-in cabinets using solid plywood rather than MDF or particle board. Plywood provides superior moisture resistance, prevents sagging under heavy loads, and holds mechanical screws firmly in Singapore's tropical humidity.
- **Complimentary 3D Renderings**: Every project receives complimentary, photorealistic 3D visual renderings and material palettes before construction begins to eliminate miscommunication.
- **Transparent Quotations**: Fixed, transparent pricing structure with detailed bills of quantities and zero hidden variation costs.
- **Certified Subcontractors**: All site execution is handled by licensed and registered Singapore tradesmen adhering to HDB renovation guidelines, BCA standards, and EMA electrical codes.

## Educational Insights & Technical Guides
- [Plywood vs. MDF Carpentry Guide](https://www.luxcraft.sg/blog/plywood-vs-mdf-built-in-carpentry-singapore): In-depth material breakdown explaining humidity swelling rates, screw retention, and lifespan differences in Singapore.
- [Kitchen Countertop Comparison](https://www.luxcraft.sg/blog/quartz-vs-sintered-stone-vs-compact-top-singapore): Comparing Quartz, Sintered Stone, and Compact Tops on heat resistance, porosity, and durability.
- [Entryway DB Cabinet Optimization](https://www.luxcraft.sg/blog/maximizing-hdb-bto-db-cabinet-luxexplains-guide): Smart carpentry techniques for HDB electrical distribution boxes.
- [Architectural Lighting Guide](https://www.luxcraft.sg/blog/the-art-of-lighting-placement-and-temperature): Color temperature selection (2700K - 4000K) and layered cove lighting.
